inputs.text: Red diamond marks ONLY on her; no letters or text anywhere. Lavishly embellished fairy portrait of the diamond queen with very long flowing red-orange hair crowned by a diamond tiara and tiny glowing star-flowers woven through her curls, a diamond pendant necklace and ruby bracelets on both wrists, translucent butterfly wings veined with ruby diamonds and trailing golden sparkle dust, white gown embroidered with gold filigree and scattered red diamond gems over lace sleeves, both arms graceful and fully visible with delicate hands, one hand lifted toward a swirl of luminous butterflies, standing in a moonlit fairy ring of giant glowing blue and violet mushrooms with dewdrop sparkle, drifting lantern-light spores, curling ferns, lily bells, fireflies rising through mist, hyper-detailed fantasy illustration, radiant glow, deep teal night with golden accents
